notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Development Update: Pre-Beta

Hello wonderful people!

The game, as you may know, hasn't released on the original planned release date.
As this is a passion project, it only ever really moves forward when I have the time and motivation for it. Recently, I haven't had much time, and upon my return, I have been so consumed by bugfixing that there has been little time for implementing new content which would allow me to say the game was finally in a release-worthy state. The alpha testing feedback I have been recieving has been invaluable, and reminded me that quality of life and responsive, intuitive design is a really big deal, so I've redoubled my efforts to make Ice Cold Case a consistent and user friendly experience. This of course has been taking a lot of time, so thank you for everyone's patience as this is done.

Hopefully, there will be enough progress towards release that there will be more news here soon.

Stay tuned!

- Asterhysk
